build_VitPointmapHead: build a VitPointmapHead decode head with configurable deconv and conv layers for 3D pointmap prediction
create_make_conv_layers: create convolutional layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU activation from given channel and kernel size sequences
create_make_deconv_layers: create deconvolutional upsample layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU for supported kernel sizes 2, 3, or 4
run_forward: run the forward pass through deconv layers, bilinear interpolation, and conv layers to produce 3-channel pointmap logits
run_loss_by_feat: run loss computation by separating X, Y, Z channels, interpolating to label size, and applying consistency or standard decode loss
